description: This Java source file defines the ProductPrice entity class used for representing pricing details of products in a sales management system. It includes fields for price amount, type, special pricing dates, and associated descriptions and availability.

classes.name: ProductPrice
classes.description: Entity class representing product pricing details, including price amount, type, special offer dates, default status, and relations to descriptions and availability.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product price.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product price.

methods.name: getProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the main price amount for the product.

methods.name: setProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Sets the main price amount for the product.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Gets the start date for special pricing, with cloning to avoid external modification.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for special pricing, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Gets the end date for special pricing, with cloning.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for special pricing, cloning the input.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the special price amount.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Sets the special price amount.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions associated with this price.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this price.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Checks if this is the default price.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Marks this price as default or not.

methods.name: setProductAvailability
methods.description: Associates a ProductAvailability entity to this price.

methods.name: getProductAvailability
methods.description: Returns the availability information linked to this price.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for the product price.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifier for the product price.

methods.name: setProductPriceType
methods.description: Sets the type of product price (e.g., one-time, recurring).

methods.name: getProductPriceType
methods.description: Gets the type of product price.
